method: 9 Opus Explore readers (print + WG raw ops + every carrier) each followed by an Opus adversarial verifier; findings applied by 4 family agents + 4 verifiers (wf_ad64c344-20d, wf_ce569669-9f5)

confirmed.summary: Hopeful Athamaru does not carry its printed size change to Large — the character stays Medium off the athamaru chassis.
Flying Animal never delivers the animal attack the print grants; WG grants it via a record and our own sibling heritage running-animal already carries the picker.
Wisp Fetchling does not carry its printed size change to Small — the character stays Medium off the fetchling chassis.
Wisp Fetchling never grants the trained Acrobatics proficiency the print gives (nor its already-trained redirect).
Forge-Blessed Dwarf carries the same patron-deity picker twice — an `effectChoices` block and a `choice` block with identical prompt and identical nine options — and the builder renders both.

Our situationalBonuses entry for Nine Lives Catfolk restates, on the very same dying pill, what the structured recoveryDcIgnoresDyingValue field already computes and explains — and hard-codes a DC that other records can change.
Whisper Elf's flat-check DC reduction against concealed and hidden targets is modelled by neither side, and our own registry already carries the identical clause for another record.

Strong-Blooded Dwarf's poison-affliction stage reduction on successes and critical successes is modelled by neither side, though our registry already carries the identical clause verbatim for another record.
Hopeful Athamaru's 10-foot hope aura (+1 circumstance to allies' saves vs fear) has no mechanical carrier on either side — it survives only as prose in the description.

Stoutheart Centaur's ancestry-HP override (10 instead of 8) is delivered by no carrier on our side — the heritage record has no HP field and the only heritage HP lane (alternateAttributes.hp) is unreachable for it.

Warrior Android's whole printed content — trained in all simple and martial weapons — is delivered by nothing on our side; it ships a dataWarning telling the player to apply it by hand, while WG encodes both proficiencies.

Ganzi never puts the ganzi creature trait on the built character — it has `traits:['ganzi']` (the record's own tag) but no `grantsCreatureTraits`, the field every one of our other 16 well-formed versatile heritages uses for exactly this pri

Ganzi's aonId points at the Ganzi TRAIT page (trait-339) instead of its heritage page (heritage-129), so the render carrier serves a one-sentence flavour stub and the player never reads a single printed mechanic of the heritage.

The Faithspeaker/Greenspeaker identity is never recorded on our character: the heritage merges the divine-or-primal declaration into a cantrip spellFilter, so the two downstream feats re-ask a question print says cannot be changed, and thei
Snaring Anadi's entire printed content — the fangs gaining grapple and trip — reaches nobody: the record has no unarmedTraits rider, so the anadi's Fangs strike renders with its ancestry traits only.
Fey Dragonet never adds Fey to the character's languages — we carry the fey creature trait and the Stealth star but no grantsLanguages.
Climbing Animal never sets the land Speed of 20 feet, so the sheet keeps the Awakened Animal chassis Speed of 5 feet.
Climbing Animal's mandatory animal attack is delivered by no carrier of ours, so the character has no unarmed Strike at all.
Rite of Reinforcement never gives the character the exoskeleton armor — the item exists in our data but the heritage has no grantsItems, so the character wears nothing and gets no AC.
Our Rock Dwarf stars split the +2 by maneuver (Fortitude vs Reposition/Shove, Reflex vs Trip) when print gives both defenses against all three, and drop the second sentence entirely.
Rock Dwarf's halved forced movement is carried by no carrier on either side — residual read.
Naari's "environmental heat effects one step less severe" is modelled by neither side — residual read.
Undine's "you can breathe both water and air" reaches the sheet from no carrier: the amphibious creature trait never sets the breathesWater capability.
The IDENTITY flag misreads their encoding: their outer select is a tradition gate, and the cantrip pick is the nested FILTERED SPELL select — there is no parity gap here.

Thalassic Azarketi's second printed clause — piercing ranged attacks keep their full range increments against underwater targets — is modelled by neither side, and it is a live combat number.

Created Fleshwarp's printed 'you don't need to eat and can't starve' is modelled by neither side, although our heritage `immunities` field has a reader and an already free-form prose vocabulary that fits it exactly.

The comparer's flags for Deep Fetchling are both false — it reported KINDS missing [choice] and 'their options cold/void, ours none' because it probes only the `choice` field, while our picker is the dedicated `choiceResistance` carrier hol

The comparer's VALUES flag for Spindly Anadi ('speed land: theirs 30, ours 5') is a false positive — it compared their absolute setValue against our bonus field without adding the anadi chassis, and our derived land Speed is 30, matching pr

Ours grants Armor Proficiency unconditionally and models neither half of the printed alternative branch — the Athletics training nor the Armor Assist skill feat — that fires when the class is already trained in all armor.

The IDENTITY flag 'theirs armorassistlegacy vs ours armorproficiency' is a comparer misread: the two feats are not competing identities for one grant — they sit in opposite branches of a single conditional, and their side grants Armor Profi

Ours delivers no language slots at all for a heritage whose entire printed effect is two chosen languages plus a Multilingual upgrade — the record carries neither languageChoices nor languageChoicesBonus, both of which already have heritage
The heritage's flat-check reduction (DC 3 concealed / DC 9 undetected) has no mechanical carrier on our side, though situationalBonuses already models exactly this clause shape for other records.
Our curated description for Liminal Fetchling drops both replacement DCs, leaving two ungrammatical fragments that state no number at all.

The instrument's 'giveTrait (their trait id 3407) unverified' cannot be verified because trait 3407 does not exist in the WG dump — their Reflection trait is 2912 — and our grantsCreatureTraits already delivers what print requires, so there
The printed licence to skip Deception checks when Impersonating your progenitor is modelled by neither side, and it is the heritage's only active benefit beyond the trait.
The heritage's second printed benefit — treating environmental cold as one step less extreme — is modelled by neither side and has no carrier anywhere in the repo.
The heritage's second printed benefit — environmental heat one step less extreme — is modelled by neither side and has no carrier anywhere in the repo.
Both non-resistance clauses of this heritage — the wet-cold exemption and automatic depth-pressure adaptation — are modelled by neither side.

House Drake never grants the Diabolic language: the heritage record carries no grantsLanguages field, and its ancestry (dragonet) grants only Common and Draconic with additional:0 and no options list, so the printed language grant reaches n

The 'jaws count as silver' half of House Drake's printed sentence has no carrier on our side — situationalBonuses.ts already holds the OTHER half of the same sentence (+1 circumstance damage vs fiends), so the silver marker is a split-sente
The description of the activity this heritage grants has lost its damage dice, its damage-type clause and its save type.
WG grants the Change Shape ability the print names; we grant only its hybrid-form jaws, and no beastkin Change Shape action exists in our data at all.
WG hands the character the coral plate armor the print describes; our record delivers nothing at all and the armor does not exist in our data.
The printed Athletics training never lands on a built character, because our 16-option effectChoices picker has no default and build.ts only auto-resolves single-option picks.
The printed Deception training never lands on a built character — the instrument flag is a real defect, not a comparer misread.
Our built character stays Large: the heritage carries no sizeSet even though build.ts's size code was written for exactly this sentence.
The unconditional +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex is a real number on their sheet and only a display star on ours.
Print grants two innate cantrips; both sides grant one, and our description was rewritten to match the single grant rather than the print.

Aphorite never confers the aphorite CREATURE trait: our record carries `traits:["aphorite"]` (feat-eligibility only) and no `grantsCreatureTraits`, so the trait pill/creature-trait list stays empty where print and WG both grant it.
Mistbreath Azarketi is missing its printed land Speed 25: our record states only `speeds:{swim:15}`, so the azarketi chassis land 20 stands and the sheet walks 20 ft instead of 25 ft.

Running Animal's printed animal attack lands nowhere on our side: its `effectChoices` options carry no `grant`, and EffectGrant has no strike lane, so the picker is inert and the character gets no Claw/Jaws/Tail Strike.
The comparer's IDENTITY flag 'grants voidhealing, ours none' is a misread — we do carry void healing, under the boolean field `negativeHealing`, with readers and a sheet pill.

The Anadi Venom ability the heritage's whole text grants is delivered by no carrier on our side — the heritage record has no grantsActions, no FEAT_FEAT_GRANTS entry, no mode, no grantsFeats — so the `anadi-venom` action sits orphaned in co

Two of our carriers ask the same Adopted Ancestry question, and the live one is the wrong one: the heritage's own `choice` is dead (nothing reads `heritage:adaptive-anadi`) while the granted feat's picker is what actually unlocks feats — an

The water-dwelling branch's printed 20-foot land Speed is not delivered: our option grant carries only `speeds:{swim:20}`, so a water-dwelling awakened animal walks at the chassis 5 feet instead of 20.
The animal attack every awakened animal is printed to have is delivered by neither our heritage nor our ancestry, so a Swimming Animal character has no natural attack at all.

The heritage's language clause is encoded by no field on our side — nothing lets a heritage widen the owning ancestry's additional-languages list, so the printed "Add Draconic" sentence lands nowhere.
